trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(td:Document), (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t), (p)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(pd:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t), (o)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(od:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (c)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(cd:Document) WHERE (CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) <= 2005 OR p.position = 'Backcourt' OR CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 41) RETURN t.team_name AS col1, SUM(DISTINCT CAST(c.area AS DOUBLE) * 2.58999) AS col2
